name: sumi
description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 21 knowledge skills, 21 commands. Commands: /guide (phase-based design companion), /taste (sector style direction), /vibe-check (UX audit), /ship (component builder), /roast (design critique), /screen (screen builder), /inspo (inspiration), /benchmark (competitive analysis), /brain-scan (cognitive audit), /include (accessibility), /trust-scan (AI UX audit), /drip (design tokens), /extract (Figma to code), /pulse (UX metrics), /judge (design review), /flow (user flow audit), /dark-scan (dark pattern detection), /copy-check (content audit), /responsive (responsive audit), /onboard (onboarding flow), /remix (component remix). Covers NNG heuristics, cognitive psychology, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, accessibility (WCAG 2.2+3.0), mobile/desktop/web, motion, AI/spatial/voice UX, design systems, and 20+ industry verticals.
